title: NETHERMIND Beat Sheet v0.2
description: The creative half of shot planning: what each shot shows and why. Written by a person, by an LLM (shotplanner/beats.py), or drafted by the offline heuristic. shotplanner/compiler.py turns it into a full shot plan and adds timing, continuity links, prompts, negative prompts and QC checks, so none of that is written by hand.

visual_information.description: Split every sentence into the separate things the viewer must SEE to understand it. Example: 'When injured it can transform back into an earlier life stage' -> adult body / visible injury / the transformation / the earlier stage it becomes.

narration.description: The exact words spoken over this shot, copied from the script. The shots' narration joins to make the whole script.

subject.description: Optional. Defaults to the name of the first reference in refs.

end_state.description: Leave out if the state does not change during the shot.

environment.description: Optional extra detail about the environment for this shot only, added after the reference description.

lighting.description: Optional. Overrides style.lighting for this shot.

mode.description: Optional. If left out, the compiler picks i2v_first_last when any ref changes state and i2v_single_keyframe otherwise.

must_happen.description: Events during the clip, checked on the video only (e.g. 'the fish swallows the jellyfish').
